newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker quotes weak in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker quotes weak in dull trade.

text.p: Singapore bunker suppliers lowered their quotes slightly on Monday to attract more enquiries in a listless market, traders said.
The 380-cst grade was quoted by majors at about $95/$97 per tonne while the 180-cst was at $101/$103.
"You are lucky if you can fix a (380-cst grade) deal at $95.00. There are only few enquiries today but suppliers are as many as before," said one trader, noting the usual thin talk on Mondays.
MDO and gas oil were quoted below $180 and $190 per tonne respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (65 8703571)
